title: Split a Hot Counter, Pay on Reads
description: A viral post's like counter saturates one shard. The team splits increments among eight salted sub-counters. What cost must the read path now handle?

options.text: Every update must still lock the original unsalted row.
options.explanation: Keeping that common lock would retain the very bottleneck salting is meant to remove.

options.text: Reads become free because each sub-counter is smaller.
options.explanation: The total is distributed, so one sub-counter cannot answer the complete count.

options.text: Read and sum eight values, optionally caching the total for an acceptable interval.
options.explanation: Salting spreads writes at the cost of read fan-in and potentially staler cached totals. Apply it to detected hot keys rather than every entity.

options.text: Use a queue instead of reading any sub-counter.
options.explanation: A queue does not provide the aggregate value and does not create sustained storage capacity.
